source: UNCTAD TRAINS Online, detailed NTM search: HS 170220 (maple sugar and maple syrup), affected market Canada, import and export measures, fetched through api-trains2.unctad.org (the API behind trainsonline.unctad.org). Fields kept: ntmCode, measureDescription (whitespace collapsed and cut short; JP rows at 300 characters, others at 160), affectedCountriesNames ('World' when the measure applies to all origins), regulationTitle, and hsChapters = number of distinct HS chapters the measure covers (0 = TRAINS records no HS scope). For MX, KR, DE and AU, rows in chapters that are not compliance steps (D, F-P), rows covering 60+ chapters, and exact duplicates were not saved.
